summary: 22 features and 5 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • claude-helper: remove PermissionMode from provider configuration (850cbf8)
  • frontend-config: add proposal creation recent repository slots (a22ae3e)
  • autotask: add special emergency team fallback hero selection (c153523)
  • resources: add UI Master prompt image cache entries (1f31a3e)
  • metadata: add conversation title optimization initialization (3c9641f)
  • autotask: add UI Master scenario and target repository support (8fe8660)
  • hero: add UI Master Scene settings management (8f417b8)

HagiCode-org/web

  • ui-master: add command documentation links (9967360)
  • proposal: make recent repository slot count configurable (9d76f6e)
  • settings: add proposal creation settings with configurable recent repository slots (8202134)
  • conversation: use TextSwitch for edit mode toggle (6804327)
  • settings: improve edit mode toggle presentation (a2b39dc)
  • ui: add TextSwitch component (6717e95)
  • session: enhance idea workflow presentation (eef12d5)
  • ui-master: persist recent repository selections (303fb1d)
  • proposal: persist recent repository selections on creation (c8aa908)
  • proposal: add recent selections section to repository panel (d61aea2)
  • utils: add recent repository selection persistence (019228e)
  • session: enhance SessionList components (3cbaae8)
  • proposal: update ProposalStageRail components (1bf5179)
  • session: add UI Master session creation (e31bafb)
  • hero: add UI Master scene settings configuration (8cf0f10)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • hero-resolver: filter legacy PermissionMode overrides for ClaudeCodeCli (510f025)
  • hero-app: remove unsupported CLI parameters for ClaudeCodeCli (1d21a6c)
  • copilot: add streaming error handling and authentication gap retry (9c487bc)
  • git: restore full detail as default for Git status API (7cae1bb)
  • codex: persist thread binding early for interrupted turns (49c12fb)
